activity_summary: Before you went out you said you had no valentine to send. You were not in the Knave. You were taking a penny to the Rose, and you left dinner. The moon was full by the almanac. The letter stayed on the desk.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the Rose, left the desk, and did not eat the dinner.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Named the day and the absence of a ribbon.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Noted that he was leaving the dinner, and that the loaf would keep.

entities.name: the Knave
entities.context: Mentioned in A penny, not a ribbon

entities.name: Long Meg of Westminster
entities.context: Mentioned in A penny, not a ribbon

facets.activity: Left dinner and took a penny to the Rose

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I have no ribbon. I have a penny.
